name: Holidays on the Farm at Winton Woods
venue: Winton Woods Farm and Equestrian Center
when_note: Select nights December 3 to 6, 10 to 13 and 17 to 23, 4 to 8 PM
cost: Adults $12 online, kids 3 to 12 and seniors $10 online, ages 2 and under free
paras: Great Parks of Hamilton County turns the Winton Woods Farm and Equestrian Center, 10073 Daly Road, into a holiday evening for the whole family. Holidays on the Farm runs on select nights, December 3 to 6, 10 to 13 and 17 to 23, from 4 to 8 PM.

Under the glow of lights, families can ride old-fashioned hayrides, take pony rides, meet farm animals, make holiday crafts and have a photo with Santa. The park also serves hot cocoa and sells Great Parks holiday merchandise.

Single night tickets are $12 for adults and $10 for kids 3 to 12 and seniors 65 and older when bought online, with on-site prices of $15 and $13. Kids 2 and under are free. Pony riders must be at least two years old, no taller than 48 inches and no heavier than 85 pounds, and pets are not permitted.
tip: Buy tickets online to save a few dollars, and remember pets are not permitted at the farm.
